description: The Government Issue G.I Gore-Tex Watch Cap is the perfect item to add to your outdoor gear collection this cold weather season. Designed with a blend of Gore-Tex and wool, the knit cap efficiently repels moisture and wind to keep your head cool and dry when you face vigorous outdoor climates. The double layer construction provides additional warmth when you are performing any cold weather activities. The watch cap is made in the USA.
